title: Return policy
text: Most items can be returned within 14 days of delivery, as long as they're unused and in their original packaging. A few things can't be returned, including perishables, personal-care products, and gift cards. Once we receive your return and it passes inspection, we issue your refund.
questions: What is the time frame for returning items after I receive my shipment?
Are there any products I can't return to Zapp?
How do I ensure my return qualifies for a refund?
